cover_letter:
Dear Charlotte,

I'm writing to apply for the Marketing Manager position at noah. Your mission to help organisations adopt AI resonates deeply with my own work: I use AI tools daily to automate research, content and audits, and I've built websites optimised for both traditional and AI-powered search. I'm excited by the opportunity to bring this hands-on, AI-first approach to a fast-growing company.

In my current roles as a freelance SEO and AI search specialist and as a junior digital marketer at Episto, I've run SEO and content campaigns for client websites, managed CMS content, and used analytics to track results. I've built and optimised multiple WordPress sites from scratch, including implementing structured data and llms.txt for AI search visibility. While I haven't run LinkedIn Ads specifically, I've worked with Google Ads and have a strong analytical mindset for optimising campaigns toward pipeline. I'm comfortable setting up, testing and reporting on paid campaigns, and I understand the importance of MQLs and meetings over vanity metrics.

I'm social and organised, comfortable talking with senior people, and I think like a seller—I understand the importance of qualified meetings and follow-up. I've organised events and worked side by side with sales teams to improve outbound sequences. I speak fluent English and am improving my Dutch, and I'm eager to work in a bilingual environment.

I'd love to bring my hands-on B2B marketing experience and AI-driven approach to noah. I'm confident I can help you deliver a steady flow of qualified meetings and build a marketing engine that sales loves.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
